instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Design a module that implements a 4-bit ripple carry adder/subtractor. The module should have three inputs (A, B, and sub) and two outputs (sum and carry). The inputs A and B are 4-bit vectors, and sub is a single bit that determines whether the module should perform addition or subtraction. If sub is high, the module should perform subtraction (A-B), and if sub is low, the module should perform addition (A+B). The output sum is the result of the addition or subtraction, and the output carry is the carry bit from the most significant bit.
label: trojan
